**Certificate of Accreditation**

**The certificate number:** JAS Test – 072

**The Jordanian Accreditation System – Accreditation Unit has accredited:**

**Laboratories of Water, Energy and Environment Center (WEEC) – The University of Jordan / Amman**

---

**Contact Information:**
- Address: Queen Rania St. - Amman – Jordan
- Tel: 0096265355000
- Fax: 0096265300803
- Amman 11942 Jordan
- Email: weec@ju.edu.jo

---

**Accreditation Details:**
Issued in Amman on: **01-03-2025**  
is valid until: **28-02-2030**  
Initial accreditation date: **04-01-2015**  
This certificate was updated on: **28-07-2025**

---

**Scope of Accreditation:**
Under the terms of the “Instructions for Administration of Accreditation Procedures of Conformity Assessment Bodies No. (4) for the Year 2022” and the requirements of the International Standard ISO/IEC 17025:2017 as the laboratory is competent to carry out:

- **Chemical Testing of Water and Wastewater and Microbiological Testing of Water, Biofilms, and Sediments and Wastewater according to Annex No. (1)**

---

**Important Notes:**
- The annexes and the documents submitted in connection with the accreditation certificate are deemed to form an integral part of the certificate. Thereof, any amendments made to the certificate are to be reflected also on them.
- The certificate consists of two pages and the second page contains information on the history of CAB accreditation.
- The approved and most recent version of this document can be viewed on JAS-AU website using the link: [https://au.gov.jo](https://au.gov.jo)
- The accredited laboratory is obliged to issue test reports carrying the accreditation symbol only in the scope of accreditation specified in annex no. (1), and according to the internal instructions "Instructions for the use of JAS symbol and for the year 2024" prepared by the Accreditation Unit (JAS-AU).
- The Accreditation Unit (JAS-AU) is authorized to withdraw this accreditation certificate if the requirements specified in the “Instructions for Administration of Accreditation Procedures of Conformity Assessment Bodies” No.(4) for the year 2022 and ISO/IEC 17025:2017 are no longer met.

---

**Accreditation Unit Director**  
**Eng. Lana Marashdeh** 

---

Note: The document includes a watermark or logo in the background, which signifies its official status.
